agenda_items.description:
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; in camera meeting procedures; information items not subject to discussion; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and hybrid participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
Except where otherwise indicated, reports requiring Council consideration will be presented to Council on November 7, 2025 in Audit Committee Report 14.
The deadline to register by phone to speak, or submit written comments or visual presentations is 4 pm on November 3, 2025, and the deadline to register to speak by email is 8:30 am on November 4, 2025.
agenda_items.minutes: This meeting was called as a special meeting pursuant to Section 87 of the Procedure By-law (No. 2025-100).

motions.motion_text: There were no Declarations of Interest.

sub_agendas_items.minutes:
At the outset of discussion on this item, the Committee carried Motion No. AC 2025-14-01, below.
Nathalie Gougeon, Auditor General, Joanne Gorenstein, Deputy Auditor General, and Atul Arora, Audit Principal, presented an overview of the report and answered questions from the Committee.  A copy of the slide presentation is filed with the Office of the City Clerk.
Sathish Kumar, Director, Construction Advisory and Disputes (BDO Canada LLP), and Melissa Fournier, Partner, Risk Advisory Services (BDO Canada LLP), also answered questions from Committee.
The following responded to questions to City staff from Committee:

Following discussions, the Committee considered the report recommendation(s) as follows:

motions.motion_text: BE IT RESOLVED THAT the Audit Committee approve the addition of the report entitled “Office of the Auditor General (OAG) – Follow-up: Audit of Lansdowne Sprint 1” (ACS2025-OAG-BVG-014), distributed and published on November 3, 2025, pursuant to subsection 89(3) of the Procedure By-law (being by-law no. 2025-100) to allow for consideration of this matter.

Report Recommendation(s)
That the Audit Committee receive the Follow-Up report and recommend that Council consider and approve the recommendations.
